news.notice.welcome.message:
ShroudForge builds on work already done by the Enshrouded modding community. Brabb3l laid important foundations with kfc-parser and EML. Shroudtopia made runtime mods possible, including loading, unloading, and configuring them while the game is running. Thank you to everyone who shares tools, examples, knowledge, and time with the community.

ShroudForge brings mod management, runtime features, and asset preparation together in one place. Documented mods from the EML ecosystem should remain usable too. The links below take you to the getting started guide, EML, kfc-parser, and Shroudtopia. The contributor list underneath shows people whose work on GitHub is connected to ShroudForge. 💚
news.notice.modsGuide.title: Los cinco mods incluidos 🧩
news.notice.modsGuide.message:
Hola {username}. ShroudForge incluye cinco mods. Consulta sus ajustes y detalles en «Instalados».

• SF Survival: Ajusta resistencia, maná, oxígeno, frío, regeneración, durabilidad de armas y daño por caída.
• SF Unlimited Flight: Ajusta los controles y valores del planeador. Permite ascender sin consumir resistencia.
• SF Crafting Essentials: Cambia los tiempos de producción, elimina costes de recetas y conserva objetos compatibles al usarlos.
• SF Unlock Blueprints: Cambia los requisitos de recetas al primer indicio del Altar de la Llama. Desactivado de forma predeterminada. Requiere reiniciar.
• World Editor: Captura, guarda, gira y coloca planos de partes del mundo.

Los cambios en los archivos del juego se preparan antes de iniciarlo.
news.notice.configuration.title: Ready to make your first mod, {username}? 🛠️
news.notice.configuration.message: Every mod starts with mod.json: its name, version, authors, dependencies, and the features it needs. ShroudForge-specific switches, settings, buttons, and links live in the optional extended.mod.json. The Modloader can show those settings to players, and your Lua code can read them through the ShroudForge API. You do not need to learn every field at once. Start with the working Hello Ember template, then read the extended.mod.json guide to see how settings are defined and shown in the Modloader.
news.notice.discord.title: A question, an idea, or just curious, {username}? 💬
news.notice.discord.message: Have a question, an idea, or just want to see what others are building? The Enshrouded Modding Discord brings players and mod authors together to share and help out. You can just read along at first. Joining is completely optional.
news.notice.localization.title: Welcome! Herzlich willkommen! Bienvenue ! ¡Te damos la bienvenida!
news.notice.localization.message: El francés y el español ya están en beta. Ayuda a traducir ShroudForge en Crowdin, sugiere un idioma o informa de errores abajo.
news.localization.reportIssue: Informar de un problema de traducción
news.notice.applySettings.title: All saved, {username} 🔧
news.notice.applySettings.message: Your choice is saved as soon as you apply it. What happens next depends on the mod: runtime-only mods can use new settings straight away when their code reads the current value from a lifecycle or action callback. Changes to game files are prepared before the next launch, so close Enshrouded first. If the Modloader says a restart is needed, your change is saved and waiting for the next session.
news.notice.feedback.title: Noticed something, {username}? 🐛
news.notice.feedback.message:
A bug, a confusing message, or something that feels harder than it should? Feel free to let us know. Small notes help make ShroudForge clearer and more reliable.

The most helpful details are your Enshrouded and ShroudForge versions, which mods were enabled, what you expected, and what happened instead. Steps to reproduce the issue make it much easier to investigate. A short log excerpt can help too.

Please remove personal information before sharing logs. If the issue only happens with one specific mod, please contact its author as well. The links below open the issue form and explain how ShroudForge mod logs work.
news.notice.support.title: Enjoying ShroudForge? ☕
news.notice.support.message:
Hey {username}, it is lovely to see you trying ShroudForge! If you enjoy the project and would like to support my work on it, you can buy me a coffee. The contribution goes directly to me and supports my work on ShroudForge.

There is no expectation at all. Trying the loader, sharing feedback, or reporting an issue already helps the project a lot. Thank you! 💚

settings.modules.diagnosticJob.worldEdit: World Editor: comparación de lectura de la API A/B
Compara el cursor, la autoridad del servidor, los objetos y los vóxeles mediante la API pública de World Editor. Solo lectura.
Observa campos de entrada reflejados, registros y versiones procesadas entre sesiones del mundo. Solo lectura.
World Editor: llamada registrada de Impact A/B
Llama a la operación IsSameEntity autorizada en cuatro casos A/B y comprueba el rechazo de operaciones no autorizadas. No modifica los datos del mundo.
World Editor: escritura y restauración de una celda A/B
Solo para mundos de prueba desechables. Guarda un chunk completo como estado inicial, vacía una celda ocupada, verifica el resultado y la restaura. Los datos de pruebas anteriores impiden repetirla.
